headline: Kian McMahon-Brown Makes Full Debut
standfirst: He is named in the starting eleven for his first full appearance.
body: Kian McMahon-Brown has been given his first full start, taking a place in the starting eleven for the match. The appearance represents his debut in a complete role after previously featuring only as a substitute. The opportunity allows him to play the entire game and demonstrate his capabilities from the opening whistle.
author: Jack Deane
_facts: Kian McMahon-Brown is making his full debut.
He is included in the starting lineup.

headline: Gabriel Otegbayo named in starting XI
standfirst: Louie Barry will miss the next three months due to injury.
body: Gabriel Otegbayo has been handed a place in the starting lineup for the upcoming fixture, indicating the manager's confidence in his abilities. Meanwhile, Louie Barry has suffered an injury that is projected to keep him out of action for approximately three months, ruling him out of the immediate squad. The team will need to adapt its attacking options in his absence.
author: Jack Deane
_facts: Louie Barry is expected to be unavailable for three months because of injury
Gabriel Otegbayo has been selected to start the match

headline: Tom O’Connor and Liam Kelly named in starting XI
standfirst: David Okagbue and Evan Weir are listed among the substitutes.
body: Tom O’Connor and Liam Kelly have been selected to start the upcoming fixture, while the bench will feature David Okagbue and Evan Weir as part of the substitute options. The announcement was posted on social media, confirming the lineup for the team.
author: Jack Deane
_facts: Tom O’Connor will start the match

headline: Troy Parrott scores winning goal against Real Madrid
standfirst: He gave a brief interview following the decisive strike.
body:
![](img/articles/troy-parrott-scores-winning-goal-against-real-madrid/lead.jpg)

Troy Parrott delivered the decisive goal that secured victory over Real Madrid, finding the net in the evening match. After the win, he spoke to the media, answering a few questions about his performance and the match outcome. The goal proved decisive in the contest.
author: Jack Deane
_facts: Troy Parrott scored the winning goal against Real Madrid
